title: Each file in the rulings store must parse as JSON before it is committed
why: roadmap/rulings/mac-runner-token-scope.json held unescaped quotes from triage's commit b9713003c and did not parse, so every reader of the store either failed on it or skipped it unseen. Found 06:31 CST Nov 13 and fixed by triage.
note: Fix: the record branch's pre-commit check (roadmap/build.py --check-staged) refuses a staged roadmap/rulings/*.json that does not parse. Check, red first: stage a broken ruling file and the commit is refused. 10:01 CST Nov 13: done. Landed on roadmap as merge 5949438e4 (lane head f13e89f58; build.py +109/-30, test_build.py +185). Review: round 1 FAIL then fixed, round 2 PASS, round 3 PASS with positive net value; 61 tests; roadmap/test_build.py PASS on the merged tree. Known limits, no debt: a clean merge skips pre-commit; amend base; symlinks.
